KubeAppCreationMeta.description:
``event_meta`` shape for ``EventCode.APP_START_CREATION``.

Captures decisions pinned at kube_app creation time so later steps can
consult them later without re-deriving.

``use_v2_workflow`` is the v2 dispatcher marker — set to ``True`` when the
kube_app runs the unified ``KubeAppWorkflow`` (ENGP-336 Stream E); its
teardown is deferred to the marker-cleanup project.

``user_files_storage_usage_mode`` is the personal-files mount mode resolved
once at creation, so EFS provisioning, S3 Files provisioning and helm
rendering all read one answer and cannot disagree. ``None`` on apps created
before it shipped, which read as the pre-feature default (``no_mount``).
KubeAppCreationMeta.title: KubeAppCreationMeta

NodeSchedulingMeta.description:
Metadata captured at node-scheduling time.

``node_preexisted`` is True when the pod landed on a node that existed
before the pod was created, False when the node was provisioned for
the pod (cold start).
NodeSchedulingMeta.title: NodeSchedulingMeta

post.description: Create an uploadUrl and destination S3 URI for managed storage or a storage integration. PUT the raw file bytes to uploadUrl without platform credentials, then use destination as the script definition URI. For compatibility with managed storage URLs using S3 Signature V2, PUT with an empty Content-Type header (curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type:' --data-binary @script.py '<uploadUrl>'). Signature V2 signs the empty content type even though Content-Type is absent from the presign parameters; adding a nonempty value can fail signature verification. Do not send multipart form data or platform credentials to uploadUrl.
post.summary: Create a presigned file upload URL

get.description: Compatibility endpoint returning a 307 redirect to storage. WARNING: curl -L with a custom X-API-Key header can forward the platform credential to the redirect host. Prefer GET /storage/{storage_id}/file-download-url/{path}: authenticate once to obtain downloadUrl, then fetch it WITHOUT platform credentials.
